close_reason: Already fixed: comment at common/mod.rs:855-858 already explains the TOCTOU protection from the single-lock covering duplicate check + thread assignment + insert.
description: common/mod.rs MemoryBackend::import_email: the duplicate Message-ID check and thread assignment and email insert all happen under a single Mutex lock acquisition (lines ~660-780). This eliminates the TOCTOU window where two concurrent import_email calls for the same message could both pass the duplicate check then both insert. A contributor might 'optimize' by doing the check outside the lock to reduce lock hold time — this would reintroduce the race. The single-lock-covers-check-and-insert pattern is the correct approach and must be preserved.
title: import_email duplicate check and thread assignment under single lock
